items.english: A notebook, harvest record or sales record can help. Do not add kilograms to bunches. Leave figures blank when your records do not cover a full year.
items.draft: Incwadi yamanqaku, irekhodi yesivuno okanye irekhodi yentengiso ingakunceda. Musa ukudibanisa iikhilogram nezinyanda. Shiya amanani engabhalwanga xa iirekhodi zakho zingaqukanga unyaka opheleleyo.
items.backtranslation: A notebook, harvest record or sales record can help you. Do not mix kilograms and ... (izinyanda). Leave numbers unwritten when your records do not cover the whole year.
items.problem: Wrong/isiZulu-form term: "izinyanda" carries the isiZulu plural prefix (isiXhosa would be iinyanda) and is not a clear everyday word for "bunches" (e.g. spinach bunches). The warning not to add kilograms to bunches could be missed. Coordinator: used the isiXhosa plural iinyanda (bundles) rather than the loanword.
items.corrected: Incwadi yamanqaku, irekhodi yesivuno okanye irekhodi yentengiso ingakunceda. Musa ukudibanisa iikhilogram neenyanda. Shiya amanani engabhalwanga xa iirekhodi zakho zingaqukanga unyaka opheleleyo.

items.problem: Same term problem as surveyGuideProduction: "izinyanda" is an isiZulu-prefixed, unclear word for "bunches" in the unit example. Coordinator: used the isiXhosa plural iinyanda (bundles) rather than the loanword.

items.english: Leave a question blank if you are not sure. An unknown is more useful than a guess.
items.draft: Shiya umbuzo ungaphendulwanga ukuba awuqinisekanga. Into engaziwayo iluncedo ngakumbi kunokuqashela.
items.backtranslation: Leave a question unanswered if you are not sure. Something unknown is more helpful than guessing.
items.problem: "ukuqashela" means to notice/take care, not to guess; the sentence ("unknown is more useful than noticing") loses the point that a guess is worse than leaving it blank. (Moderate confidence on the verb.)
items.corrected: Shiya umbuzo ungaphendulwanga ukuba awuqinisekanga. Into engaziwayo iluncedo ngakumbi kunokuqikelela.

items.english: Check the production entries and areas before saving. Use positive numbers or zero; leave unknowns blank.
items.draft: Jonga okubhaliweyo kwemveliso nobungakanani bemimandla phambi kokugcina. Sebenzisa amanani angaphezu kweqanda okanye iqanda; shiya izinto ongazaziyo zingabhalwanga.
items.backtranslation: Check what is written of production and the sizes of areas before saving. Use numbers greater than zero or zero (literally: greater than egg or egg); leave things you do not know unwritten.
items.problem: "Positive numbers or zero" rendered as "greater than egg or egg" using colloquial iqanda=zero; on a production form with an eggs category this can be read as eggs and is redundant ("more than zero or zero"). Rewritten with 0 explicit.
items.corrected: Jonga okubhaliweyo kwemveliso nobungakanani bemimandla phambi kokugcina. Sebenzisa amanani angaphezu kwe-0 okanye i-0; shiya izinto ongazaziyo zingabhalwanga.

items.corrected: Khuphela izilayidi zezifundo, ingcaciso ethethwayo neziqendu ngokwahlukeneyo phantsi kwecandelo elithi

items.problem: "Farm-gate" dropped: "Amaxabiso asefama" means just farm prices; farm-gate (price at the gate, before market/shop mark-up) is the concept the page explains (see body text with "esangweni").
